summary: Asus Vivobook 16 S OLED with Arrow Lake
detected_fault: Fingerprint magnetism on the metal case
Occasional right-clicking issues due to the off-center trackpad
Battery life being less than expected (4-5 hours)
suggested_solution: Use a screen protector or wipe the metal case regularly
Adjust the trackpad settings in the BIOS or operating system
Improve battery life by adjusting power settings or using a power bank
Monitor temperatures and adjust usage patterns to prevent overheating
